references.text: The same chapter lists other physical conditions that disqualified priests from approaching the altar, including blindness and lameness.
Similar physical defects are mentioned for sacrificial animals that could not be offered to the Lord, including animals with growths or crippled limbs.
Refers to men with crushed testicles who could not enter the assembly of the Lord, related to 'meroach ashekh' (crushed testicles) in Leviticus 21:20.
Detailed laws about skin diseases (garav/scab) and how the priest was to examine and assess such conditions.
The introduction to the list of physical defects that disqualified priests from priestly service at the altar.
The continuation explaining that priests with defects could still eat from the holy offerings but not perform sacrificial service.
